## Description {#details}

<p>Typed tracking ref.</p>


<p>Track refererences of a particular type. It's useful to use this for <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mdnode">MDNode</a></em> and <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/valueasmetadata">ValueAsMetadata</a></em>.</p>
